key_insight: SUMNO turns a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, combining strong flow-prediction accuracy with a compact 9.4-million-parameter model.
engineering_relevance: SUMNO offers a parameter-efficient approach to regular-grid CFD surrogates for steady-flow prediction and unsteady-flow rollouts.
method: Spatially unrolls a multigrid V-cycle using parameter-free downsampling and upsampling with additive skip corrections.
Keeps transfer and skip pathways normalization-free.
Combines fine- and intermediate-grid convolutions with coarse-grid shifted-window attention supporting periodicity independently per axis.
evidence_signal: Across four flow benchmarks and five baselines on unseen test configurations, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, with about 30% lower 10-step rollout MSE than the strongest baseline.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to regular-grid benchmarks; performance on irregular meshes and stability over longer rollouts remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
